intro: Armenia is a small, mountainous, landlocked country, with Lake Sevan and views of Mount Ararat across the border.

chapters.title: Highlands
text: Most of Armenia is over 1,000 m high. Mount Aragats, at 4,090 m, is the highest peak. Mount Ararat, a symbol of Armenia where Noah's Ark is said to have landed, stands across the border in Turkey.
Lake Sevan is one of the largest high-altitude freshwater lakes in the world.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Summers are hot and dry, winters cold and snowy. Earthquakes are a risk.
